description: Check a domain's email deliverability with Yeevu: MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, MTA-STS, TLS-RPT, BIMI and blacklist status, with what is wrong and how to fix it. Use when someone asks why their emails go to spam, aren't delivered, or whether their email setup is correct.

domain.description: The domain to check, for example acme.com. A URL or email address also works.

name: check_email_health
title: Check email health
